qwen3-vl-8b-q4_K_M.notes: About 6 GB. Same Qwen3-VL family as the 32B model but far lighter and faster.

qwen3-vl-4b-q4_K_M.notes: About 3 GB. Use when the 8B model is still too slow, or on the 12 GB GPU.

qwen3-vl-30b-a3b-q4_K_M.purpose: high quality but still fast (MoE, text + image)
qwen3-vl-30b-a3b-q4_K_M.notes: About 20 GB. Mixture-of-Experts with roughly 3B active parameters, so it is much faster than the dense 32B model at a similar VRAM footprint.

qwen3-vl-32b-q4_K_M.notes: About 21 GB dense model. Highest quality of the Qwen3-VL profiles, but the slowest.

gpt-oss-20b.notes: About 14 GB. Use when vision-language capability is unnecessary, especially for chat-based investigation and text RAG workflows.

qwen3.6-27b-q4_K_M.notes: Newer Qwen-series model for general-purpose comparison and workflow validation.
